title: Banned and restricted herbal ingredients for medicinal use
publisher: UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
legal_basis: Human Medicines Regulations 2012, Schedule 20, Parts II and III
locator: Legislation explanation for Schedule 20 Part 2 and table row for Ephedra sinica
verified_excerpt: Part 2 permits practitioner supply at or below 600 mg (MD) and 1800 mg (MDD); if exceeded, supply is limited to registered pharmacy premises by or under pharmacist supervision.
interpretation_note: These figures are supply-channel thresholds, not an absolute prohibition or universal maximum across all lawful supply routes.
route_mapping_note: MHRA uses the term internal use; the case maps this to Oral because the platform route vocabulary has no generic internal-use value.
